description: TI TPS54426 4 A synchronous buck (D-CAP2, 700 kHz) converting VBATT (4.5-18 V) to ~4.95 V, with ENAB_RPI enable and 330k pull-down, 3.3 nF soft-start, 121k/22.1k feedback and 3.3 uH inductor. SAMWISE Raspberry Pi payload supply (RPi Interface board U1).
keywords: POWER, buck, DC-DC, regulator, 5V, TPS54426, D-CAP2, SAMWISE
